HYPOTHESES (Lean vs printed). `hn : 3 ≤ n` is the standing `n ≥ 3` of SM def:polygon and CV def:polygon. `g : WallGerm n` (SM/WallGerm.lean 13-19) is SM def:germ field for field: radius>0, continuous curve on Ioo(-r,r), `SM.Generic` (= G1 ∧ G2, SM/Generic.lean 7-13, matching sm-1-polygons.tex 99-108) off the centre and not at it. `h : g.TripleAt e f k` (SM/NamedWallPredicates.lean 22-26) = `pointZeros = ∅` (↔ SM G1 at the centre, i.e. Z_pt = ∅), `concurrences = {{e,f,k}}` (ConcurrenceTriple: card 3, pairwise `remote`, a common point in the three `edgeInterior`s = Z_c = {{e,f,g}}), and three `SignChanges` of `edgeParameter P a b - edgeParameter P a c`, where `edgeParameter P i j = det(p_j - p_i, d_j)/det(d_i,d_j)` is exactly SM's t_{ij} on E_i and `SignChanges` (SM/GermSignChange.lean 6-8) is the printed ∃δ>0, φ(P(t))φ(P(-t))<0 for 0<t<δ. So `TripleAt` is exactly the printed (T) clause (sm-1-polygons.tex, label def:walls, item (T)). `hef, hfk : rep e < rep f < rep k` with `rep i = (i-1).val+1 ∈ {1..n}`, `rep 0 = n` (CV/Setup.lean 335) is §0's "choose e<f<g in those representatives".

LEFT SIDE. `(eventOfTriple hn g h).zeroSet` with radius := g.radius, curve := g.curve (statement file 126-134), so by CV/Events.lean 559-560 it is {m | m.eval g.center = 0 ∧ ∃ t ∈ Ioo(-r,r), t ≠ 0 ∧ m.Relevant (g.curve t)}, `Relevant = Unconditional ∨ Active` (Setup 669) — CV def:event's Z (d1_setup.tex 1076-1079) and def:generic (A) verbatim. `Member` (Setup 631-636) has exactly the five printed families with the printed side conditions (G2: i ∉ {e,e+1}; G5: remote, ē<f̄; G3: pairwise remote, ē<f̄<ḡ; G4: f,g remote to e, f̄<ḡ, f,g NOT required remote to each other — as printed). G3/G4 polynomials (Setup 373-378) match d1_setup.tex 115-129 term for term; `Crosses` (Setup 385-386) is the strict two-product activation on remote pairs; `Active` for g3/g4 is "pairwise cross"/"f and g both cross e" (Setup 661-666).
